title: Jetlag event front matter
description: Front matter for one Jetlag Events in Europe event Markdown file. Calendar validity, date ordering, IANA timezone validity, and local-time ordering are semantic checks enforced by the runtime validator.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the event front-matter contract.

startDate.description: Quoted YAML string containing an ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.description: Quoted YAML string containing an ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).

startTime.description: Optional local start time in 24-hour HH:mm form.

endTime.description: Optional local end time in 24-hour HH:mm form.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for the optional local times.

hostServerId.description: Stable ID of the hosting server in servers.json.

signupUrl.description: Optional absolute HTTPS signup URI validated solely by this conservative authority/component pattern: optional userinfo, a host or bracketed IPv6 address, an optional numeric port, RFC 3986 URI characters, valid percent escapes, and at most one fragment.

imageUrl.description: Optional absolute HTTPS event image URI validated solely by this conservative authority/component pattern: optional userinfo, a host or bracketed IPv6 address, an optional numeric port, RFC 3986 URI characters, valid percent escapes, and at most one fragment.

imageAlt.description: Accessible alternative text required when imageUrl is present.

mapEmbedUrl.description: Optional absolute lowercase HTTPS Google Maps URI validated solely by this conservative pattern: the required Google Maps prefix, RFC 3986 URI characters, valid percent escapes, at most one fragment, and slash/path traversal checks.

mapTitle.description: Optional accessible heading/title for the map embed.
